Lumenbridge Payments Corp. (DEMO) is a labeled DEMO issuer (LMPC-DEMO); this is not a real SEC registrant.
Management disclosed a material weakness in ICFR: IT general controls — privileged access, segregation of duties, and change management over the payments ledger.

sources.excerpt: DEMO FILING TEXT — not a real EDGAR document. Management of Lumenbridge Payments Corp. (DEMO ISSUER) concluded that internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of December 31, 2025 because of a material weakness in IT general controls supporting the payments ledger.

DEMO FILING TEXT. Privileged access to production was granted to developers during the Q3 platform cutover and was not recertified. Several users retained combined access to initiate and approve journal-equivalent settlement adjustments.

DEMO FILING TEXT. Change-management controls did not require independent review of emergency production changes. Management stated that it has not identified a restatement to date, but the deficiencies could result in a material misstatement of settlement revenue or merchant liability that would not be prevented or detected on a timely basis.

attacks: Do not treat DEMO excerpts as facts about any real registrant.
Compensating controls mentioned in filings are often detective-only and do not reduce a MW to a SD without evidence.
Management 'has not identified a restatement to date' is not evidence that the control is effective.
Access recertification without a joiner/mover/leaver redesign typically re-opens the MW next period.
